name: Exiled Force
source_text: Offer this face-up card on your side of the field as a Tribute to destroy 1 monster on the field. If this card is used for a Tribute Summon or this card is offered as a Tribute due to other cards' effects, this card's effect is not activated.
notes: Demonstrates an ignition effect whose cost is the source itself, plus a field-wide target.
